name: @amodalai/example-invoice-approval
description: An Amodal example that reviews vendor invoices against purchase orders and a spend policy: a composite tool that matches the invoice in code and delegates the judgment to a reviewer subagent, three stores, a custom React UI with operator-gated Approve/Reject, and a preToolUse guard hook that enforces the hard rules platform-wide.

amodal.name: invoice-approval-example
amodal.description: Review vendor invoices against their purchase orders and a fictional spend policy. The invoice-reviewer subagent checks each invoice and recommends approve, hold, escalate, or reject for a human approver. The agent assists; a human decides.
